default_protocol.description: Protocol used when none is specified in the URL. One of: ftp, ftps, ssh, local, bookmark, http, https, fsp.

default_username.description: Username to use by default. Empty string means use current user for most protocols.

default_password.description: Password to use by default. Empty means prompt or email for anonymous FTP.

default_server.description: Server hostname or IP. Must be set at connect-time unless overridden.

default_port.description: Port number. 0 means use protocol default or services(5) lookup.

default_directory.description: Initial directory after login. Empty means login home.

extra_options.description: Additional key=value configuration lines for undocumented or advanced options (e.g., proxy settings). Each item must have 'key' and 'value' fields.
